name: Edwina Gein
source:
"Y-you have a nice skin. That's all."

Edwina is sweet and innocent, waiting for true happiness to come her way. She does what she can to help others, but isn't always as capable as she thinks. She is delicate and easily hurt, so don't be an ass! 

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sugarslip/serial-lover/]Kickstarter[/url]]
